clock_margin.others: shipped: serial 40, sync_margin 64 (opt 2 builds), clock_margin varied
clock_margin.note: Re-scanned with 30 random inputs per net plus extremes and boundary vectors (49 per MLP, 33 per transformer), the other constants at their SHIPPED values. The earlier edge (72, others at their defaults serial 64, sync_wait 400) does not hold there: 72 fails on tiny_model (6 of 33) with serial 40 and sync_margin 64. With the other constants at their defaults the same inputs give edge 72 (64 fails: tiny 6/33, softmax 27/33; 72 passes). Values 128, 120, 112 come from a descending scan, 96, 88, 80, 72, 64 from a targeted probe; resolution 8 units.
clock_margin.command_note: The rows were measured by the same tune.scan / tune.Bench calls through two short scripts before the flags --shipped-others, --scan-top and --resolution existed: a descending scan stopped by hand after 112, then a direct probe of 96, 80, 72, 64, 88. The command above is the equivalent and was not run as written.

net_descriptions.signed: 6-10-4 MLP, seed 3, signed input with 8 thresholds (sign pairs share waves)
net_descriptions.fold: 2-1-1 MLP, 100 signed thresholds per input: 200 waves, two clock chunks at serial 64
net_descriptions.tiny: onemap.tiny_model(): relu-attention transformer, T=3, d=4 (corridor layers)
net_descriptions.softmax: tests/test_softmax.py softmax_model(): softmax attention, T=3, d=4, H=2
net_descriptions.arch: tests/test_arch.py arch_model(attn='softmax'): RMSNorm, ReGLU MLP, softmax attention
net_descriptions.doomnames_onemap: shipped doomnames_onemap (trained, T=6, d=8, dm=16) on the prompts DOOM, HELL, ZONE
net_descriptions.doomnames_onemap_softmax: shipped doomnames_onemap_softmax (trained, T=6, d=8, dm=16) on the prompts DOOM, HELL
net_descriptions.mnist: shipped MNIST MLP (models/mnist/mlp.npz) on the first 1 shipped test digit(s): the longest crossbars (784 inputs)

machine_load_note: measured on a shared machine (Linux aarch64, 16 cores) running other jobs: 1-minute load average 16.7 to 45.9 when the entries were written. minutes and seconds_per_pass are wall times under that load; pass/fail and game tics do not depend on it (game tics are simulated)
time_box: Sched's deadline 23:25: coarse scans (descent in steps of 32, bisection to 8 units, 10 random + 10 boundary inputs per MLP); tele_gap, chunk_lead and the opt=3 constants were not measured and ship their defaults
commands_note: the serial and clock_margin tables were written by `doomformer tune --provisional --const serial,sync_wait,clock_margin,corr_gap --nets hello,signed,mlp24,tiny --inputs 6 --workers 2` (an earlier tune.py: no boundary inputs, opt=1 with the corridor rule absent, sync_wait 400); the first command regenerates them with today's input sets. sync_margin: second command; the joint run: third.
